title: CHEM 1B Readiness Quest — ItsDrDan
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Interactive review game for students preparing for CHEM 1B. Includes Skill Labs, randomized Mixed Practice, and a 12-question Readiness Check with a personalized study plan based on performance, recommended practice modes, concept checklists, and OpenStax Chemistry 2e chapter references. Practice acid–base and solution stoichiometry, titrations, limiting reactants and leftovers, dissolution and ion concentrations, predicting and balancing reactions, net ionic equations, Lewis structures, VSEPR geometry, polarity, hybridization, molecular orbital theory, core chemistry skills, matter and energy, and REDOX. REDOX Refresh includes 128 exercises across oxidation states, role identification, activity series, half-reactions, and acidic and basic balancing. Calculation problems feature solution maps with progressively unlocked worked steps. Includes hints, answer reveals, completed-work review, embedded Dr. Dan video lessons, scoring, streaks, celebration animations, a cheerful atom mascot, and responsive design.
